# Oriveo separates realtime voice models from connected web search


By OpenTools Team


The October 30 update names realtime models on mobile; web search needs a service connection.


##


Choose the voice model


Oriveo’s[October 30 changelog](https://oriveoai.com/changelog) says iOS and Android users can select OpenAI Realtime or Gemini Live models and alternate voice and text in one chat. Version 1.4.0 already offered voice conversations with any model; this is not its first voice feature.


##


Connect the search service


For[web search with any model](https://oriveoai.com/changelog) , 1.4.1 requires a connected search service and provides numbered sources. Version 1.3.0 had already added search to bundled Oriveo AI. These are separate setup choices: selecting a realtime model does not establish the search connection. The release lists Web overall, but realtime voice carries specific mobile labels.


Original explanation of separate model and service choices, not an Oriveo interface. OpenTools Team.
